name: Black Panther

abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Reduce Defensive AA: Savunma yetenek doğruluğunu belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Guaranteed Crits: Tüm vuruşlar garanti kritik vuruş olur.

signatureAbility:
For Wakanda!
Intercepting the Opponent has a 100% Chance to Purify one of each Debuff from Black Panther. Cooldown [15 - 1] seconds.
Each Bleed Debuff on the Opponent decreases their Defensive Ability Accuracy by [1.5 - 10]%. Max 5 Bleeds.

abilitySections.title: Critical Hits
content: 100% chance to inflict Bleed, dealing [4,487.85] Direct Damage over 6 seconds.

abilitySections.title: All Attacks
content: 100% Chance to gain a Cruelty Passive granting +[206.99] Critical Damage Rating for 1.25 second(s). These Cruelty Passives fall off one at a time. Max Stacks: 15
Intercepting the Opponent or striking them while they are recovering from a Heavy or Special Attack grants an additional Cruelty Passive.
When striking into an Auto-Block, Panther is Immune to Stun.

abilitySections.title: Panther's Might - Inactive Charges
content: Dashing back after a non-combo ending attack will grant 1 Indefinite Inactive Panther's Might Charge. Max: 5 Charges
Inactive Panthers Might Charges cannot be gained while Panther's Might is Active.

abilitySections.title: Panther's Might
content: Landing a Heavy Attack while at 3 or more inactive charges grants Panther's Might for 3 seconds per charge consumed.
Intercepting the Opponent or striking them while they are recovering from a Heavy or Special Attack pauses Panther's Might for 5 seconds.
Upon Activation: Gain 1 Precision Passive for each Personal Cruelty Passive active, each increasing Critical Rating by +[129.58].
Pause all Personal Cruelty Passives.
While Active:
Bleed Debuffs gain +8% Duration per Personal Cruelty Active on Black Panther.
Champion Attacks reduce the Opponents Defensive Ability Accuracy by 50%.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks 1 and 2
content: Intercepting the opponent: Each hit of this Attack is a Guaranteed Critical Hit and apply an additional Bleed Debuff.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Gain 3 Inactive Panther's Might charges. Then consume all charges and enter Panther's Might for 5 seconds per charge consumed.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: This Attack gains +[498.65] Attack Rating for each Personal Cruelty Passive Active on Black Panther.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Inflict up to 5 Bleed Debuffs, with each having a 100% Chance to Apply, and dealing [3,490.55] Direct Damage over 15 seconds.
Refresh the Duration of Panther's Might.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - For Wakanda!
content: Intercepting the Opponent has a 100% Chance to Purify one of each Debuff from Black Panther. Cooldown [15 - 1] seconds.
Each Bleed Debuff on the Opponent decreases their Defensive Ability Accuracy by [1.5 - 10]%. Max 5 Bleeds.
